selection: Same six strong sites confirmed by root independent all-site exact ACGT screen. No residual added sites. Preserve all original panel/count/v2 results.
fetch: Indexed original DNA/RNA BAM at each coordinate only; preserve all fetched read sequences/qualities/flags/CIGAR/NH/SA and mate geometry. Collapse queryname+RG only for count summaries and conflict accounting, not assertion of independent molecules.
quality_context: Compare expected/unexpected ACGT by MAPQ, NH, BQ, query-edge distance, strand, splice/indel/softclip context, and full-sequence/start families. Primary filters as original frozen panel; variants agent owns independent counts/sensitivity.
public_context: G37 transcript/exon annotation, genomic neighborhood, exact31/51nt site-centered allele contexts; no assumed paralog mechanism without sequence evidence.
origin_if_needed: At most8 unexpected-RNA +4 expected-RNA +2 unexpected-DNA full-sequence-family representatives per site, ranked by descending family-name count then deterministic sequence. Preserve counts/omissions. Frozen19nt disjoint+terminal seeds, both orientations; genome/G37 transcript nomination, <=1000hits per seed/reference and<=500windows/query/reference, mark all caps; same prior affine full-query physical-window-end conventions. No likelihood interpretation.
bounds: Sequential process;4GiB RSS;3GiB free-disk guard;newoutputs<=1GiB;no full patient BAM scan/new alignment/download/read upload.
controls: Synthetic CIGAR exact/softclip/splice/indel/low-BQ/mate-conflict cases before patient count interpretation; normal-parent/mismatch/indel controls if alternative-scoring branch used.
prohibited: No clinical interpretation, identity certainty, contamination quantification, allelic expression mechanism proof or forced artifact explanation.
